question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"round."****
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Round"** means in a circle or curve; on all sides of something. (वृत्ताकार या वक्राकार; (किसी वस्‍तु के) सभी ओर)

 
 
• **Example**: *He had a bandage right **round**__ his head.*
 
 
 
• In the given context, it is the most appropriate option to complete the sentence.
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct passage:

As a rule, you see, I'm not lugged into family rows. On the occasions when Aunt is calling Aunt like mastodons bellowing __into__ **primaeval swamps and Uncle James's letter about Cousin Mabel's peculiar behaviour is being shot __**round**__ the family circle ('Please read this carefully and send it on Jane') the clan has a tendency ______ (3) ______ ignore me. It's one of the advantages I get from ______ (4) ______ a bachelor and, according to my nearest and dearest, practically a half-witted bachelor ______ (5) ______ that.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"For"** is a preposition that indicates a purpose or duration of time. (के लिए)
 
• **"At"** is a preposition that indicates a specific location or time. (पर)
 
• **"About"** is a preposition that indicates an approximate or general amount or idea. (के बारे में)

1c7:Tb6b,

The correct answer is **"to."**<br
